content: @xterm/xterm 6.0.0 released 2025-12-22. Breaking: canvas renderer removed (WebGL or DOM only), scrollbar architecture rewrite, windowsMode/fastScrollModifier removed, Alt-to-Ctrl arrow mapping removed, overviewRulerWidth moved into overviewRuler object. New: synchronized output (mode 2026), OSC52 clipboard, ligatures, ESM builds. Addons under @xterm scope since 5.4 (old xterm/xterm-* deprecated): addon-fit 0.11.0, addon-webgl 0.19.0 released same commit as 6.0.0.
